public_api.name: Router
public_api.purpose: Authorize and queue Telegram requests, optionally selecting acknowledgement text.

public_api.name: CommandRunner
public_api.signature: CommandRunner(project, state_dir, *, store=None, skip_git_repo_check=False, model=None, profile=None, search=False, skills=(), chat_style=False)
public_api.purpose: Run the existing CLI and exact shared session with opt-in chat style.

public_api.name: acknowledgement
public_api.purpose: Choose one of five approved replies.

public_api.name: MediaOutbox
public_api.signature: MediaOutbox(workspace, state_dir); prepare(job_id, manifest); deliver(job, api, *, authorized)
public_api.purpose: Snapshot selected images and durably resume media uploads.

inputs: job mapping with id and prompt; optional existing chat/user fields
outputs: status succeeded or failed and response text; exact native session retained

storage.namespace: Configured bot/project outputs Telegram state directory
storage.migration_notes: Additive CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS delivery_snapshots. Existing jobs, cursors, users, config and shared session mapping are retained. Legacy partial replies retain original status headers and chunk boundaries.

verification.tested_commit: image milestone working tree before commit

limitations: Native image generation and Telegram upload live tests not run.
Crash between remote send and local cursor update can duplicate an attachment.
delivery_scope: Telegram adapter and conversational chat milestone; Discord remains backlog.
